newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Implats approves 389 mln shaft extension.
newsitem.headline: Implats approves 389 mln shaft extension.

text.p: Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its board had approved a 389 million rand project to proceed with the development of the No. 1 sub-vertical shaft decline extension.
The company said in its results for the six months to end-December 1996, that the shaft is planned to replace 20 percent of the company's current production.

"The project is the first step in a plan to maintain 1.0 million ounces of platinum per year whilst pushing out by at least 15 years the need for a capital intensive vertical shaft system from surface," the company said.
